package store

import (
    "os"
    "testing"
)

func TestBuildSchema6Fixture(t *testing.T) {
    s, err := Create(t.Context(), os.Getenv("OBERTH_SCHEMA_FIXTURE"), testOptions())
    requireOK(t, err)
    r, _ := accepted(t, s, "schema-six-run")
    batch := importedBatch()
    for i := range batch.Records {
        batch.Records[i].Upstream = "origin"
        batch.Records[i].Repo = r.Repo
        batch.Records[i].Title = "Schema six issue"
        batch.Records[i].Body = "Recorded before optional query indexes"
    }
    _, err = s.ImportIssues(t.Context(), importAdmin(), batch)
    requireOK(t, err)
    requireOK(t, s.Close())
}
